page.layout: One title page, one column of centred lines. The upper block is set in capitals and small type. A large woodcut vase of flowers stands in the middle. The imprint sits below it, with a ruled line and the date at the foot. Show-through of the reverse side appears in the middle.

main_text.l: Per XXX. annos in illustri schola Bremensi
Eloq. Linguae Graecae & Histor. P. P. Celeberrimi

page.notes: The scan is printed upside down relative to the reading direction. The upper block is inverted. The reverse-side show-through is not transcribed. Several lines are faint and uncertain: the Caesar line, the manuscript line, the printer's name in the imprint and the year are marked [?]. The printer's name is not legible enough to transcribe. The woodcut vase is an illustration and is not transcribed.
